PETROLEUM AGREEMENT

BETWEEN

THE GOVERNMENT OF THE CO-OPERATIVE REPUBLIC OF GUYANA

AND

TOTALENERGIES EP GUYANA B.V., QATARENERGY INTERNATIONAL E&P LLC AND PETRONAS CARIGALI GUYANA S4 B.V.

BLOCK S4

ARTICLE 11 - ROYALTY
11.1 The Contractor shall pay to the Government a royalty of ten percent (10%) of the value of all Petroleum produced and sold from the Contract Area.

ARTICLE 12 - COST RECOVERY AND PRODUCTION SHARING
12.1 Recoverable Contract Costs shall be recovered from a maximum of sixty-five percent (65%) of the total production from the Contract Area in each month.
12.2 Profit Oil shall be shared fifty percent (50%) to the Government and fifty percent (50%) to the Contractor.
